subject.title: Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Board, Area 4

text: As HLPUSD Board President and immigrant — born in El Salvador to Chinese parents — I've given everything to make sure our kids get the best education possible. Here's what I've delivered in 13 years on the Board:
- Raised $850,000 for the Wilson High School Media Center
- Raised $450,000 to build the District Soccer Field
- Donated 250+ Scholarships (over $60,000) across every School and High School Band Program
- Presented 20+ College Workshops to help our Kids Get Into College
- Created Spanish and Korean Dual Immersion Programs; Expanded Chinese Dual Immersion
- US National Blue Ribbon Schools -- Wilson High, Mesa Robles, and Wedgeworth
- Grazide Elementary -- Top 6% of U.S. Elementary Schools
- Newton Middle School -- National School to Watch
- Built Hacienda Heights Community Center with LA County
- Delivered Free Breakfast, Free SAT Testing for every Student

Attended elementary, middle, and high school in HLPUSD. My only child graduated from HLPUSD. Because of HLPUSD, I earned a USC Law School Scholarship, and have practiced as a trial attorney for 25+ years.
Every Dollar MUST be SPENT on our KIDS!

statement.disclaimer: Statements are volunteered by the candidates and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency.
